$comment: Team settings for Skill Review. Used by the CLI, the web build and Claude Code. Rules: type 'forbid' fails when the pattern is found, 'require' fails when it is missing. file: 'SKILL.md' (body, default), 'description', or 'any' (every text file in the skill). Optional 'when': regex on the description; the rule only applies to skills it matches.

rules.title: No credentials or PATs pasted into instructions
rules.fix: Remove the token, rotate it, and read it from an environment variable.

rules.title: Skill states its target surface (Claude Code, Claude.ai, Cursor)
rules.fix: Say where the skill is meant to run, and which tools it expects.

rules.title: Read-only intent is explicit for review skills
rules.fix: Review and audit skills should say they do not change code, and when changes are allowed.
